label: Claude Code (this computer)
provides: Sessions, active minutes, tools, corrections per day
how: Reads ~/.claude/projects on this computer. Each person runs it on their own machine (opt-in).

label: Claude Code (whole team, Anthropic Admin API)
provides: Per person and day: sessions, lines of code, commits, pull requests
how: Claude Code Analytics API with an Admin API key (sk-ant-admin…) in the env variable you name.

label: Microsoft 365 Copilot
provides: Per person: last day they used Copilot, per app (anonymised by default)
how: Export the per-user table in the Microsoft 365 admin center (Reports → Usage → Copilot) and list the CSV files. Export once a month to build up history.

label: GitHub Copilot
provides: Daily active and engaged users for the organisation (no per-person data)
how: GitHub Copilot metrics API with an org admin token in the env variable you name. GitHub announced a newer usage-metrics API; this connector may need updating.

label: Any AI tool (CSV)
provides: Per person and day: tool, number of uses, optional minutes
how: A CSV with the columns: date, user, tool, uses, minutes (minutes optional). Works for ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepL, Canva, Perplexity …

label: Odoo
provides: Teams and employees, booked hours, and monthly counts of sales orders, invoices, tickets, leads and tasks (whatever apps you use)
how: Odoo external API (JSON-RPC) with a user's API key in the env variable you name.

label: Personio
how: Personio API v1 with client ID and secret in the env variables you name.

label: Team list (CSV)
provides: Who is in which team, and the hourly cost per person or team
how: A CSV with the columns: user, team, hourly_cost (hourly_cost optional). Use the same user IDs or e-mails as your AI tool exports.

label: Your own KPIs (CSV)
provides: Any monthly number you track: orders, calls, tickets, revenue
how: A CSV with the columns: month (YYYY-MM), name, value.

label: Licences and prices
provides: Seats bought per AI tool and the monthly price per seat
how: Listed in the config file under connectors.licences.tools.

label: Time-saved survey (CSV)
provides: Anonymous monthly answers to: About how much time did AI save you this week?
how: Run the one-question form in Microsoft Forms or Google Forms (see docs/SURVEY.md), export the answers as CSV. Columns: month (YYYY-MM), answer, team (optional). Used only when at least 5 people answered.
